audit_type: Read-only static active-input-path investigation; no training, inference or dataset reload
conclusion: Sensor manifests are not traversed by the fixed HQ loader path because max_samples is None. No numerical input gap or reason to alter/refit the live campaign was identified.
scope: Static control-flow and frozen-source/configuration proof, not a process-level filesystem trace.
active_path: pilot.load_training_data sets max_samples=None explicitly; HQ fit_settings also saves max_samples=None.
training_common._supported_kwargs omits max_samples when None; FloodSegmentationDataset/load_samples default remains None.
compute_fit_only_names and load_stats enter any preload cap branch only when max_samples is non-None and binding.
_get_combined_modality_map has one callsite, within _slice_indices_preload after its nonbinding-cap early return.
HQ optimization fit_cap128 is applied later by pilot.selected_fit_indices to the global fit indices; it does not become loader max_samples.
Clean loading and modality-specific normalization derive optical/SAR from raw TIFF band count. Dataset.modalities and per-sensor evaluation use those raw-derived values.
Held-out validation stratification uses mask flood fraction, not the unused sensor-manifest map.
remaining_general_loader_risk: A different future call using a binding max_samples can read local and fallback optical/SAR manifests; the current HQ CLI/path never supplies such a cap. Generic future-input guarding may bind those files, but this does not require changing this campaign or its original frozen input identity.
angle_probe_scope: Each initial/selected probe uses the same first eight unaugmented optimization images for its seed (probe_names saved), yielding384 encoded angles. Its tanh saturation is a fixed-eight-image diagnostic, not global/training-set saturation or accumulated gradient coverage.
